name: Missouri
summary: Most public hunting in Missouri is on MDC's 1,000+ conservation areas (the biggest are in the Ozarks: Rocky Creek, Sunklands, Angeline, Peck Ranch, Current River), the Mark Twain National Forest, and Corps of Engineers lakes. Every conservation area has its own regulations under Chapter 11 of the Wildlife Code.
publicNote: On MDC conservation areas: no placing grain, salt, minerals or other food; no trail or game cameras; no guiding for pay; only portable tree stands Sept 1 - Jan 31, labeled with your name and address or Conservation Number. Decoys and blinds must come out daily. Each area's own rules (hours, nontoxic shot, managed hunts, daily waterfowl tags) show when you tap the area.

fees.note: Residents can buy a Small Game Hunting and Fishing permit for $22.50. Nonresident daily small game: $16.
Required for doves, waterfowl, woodcock, snipe and rails.
For drawn managed hunts. Deer taken don't count toward antlered limits.

rules: Each MDC conservation area's regulations (3 CSR 10-11) apply on top of the statewide Wildlife Code; tap an area to see them.
No grain, salt or mineral placement and no trail or game cameras on MDC areas (3 CSR 10-11.110).
Tree stands on MDC areas: portable only, Sept 1 - Jan 31, labeled with your full name and address or Conservation Number; no nails or screw-in steps (3 CSR 10-11.145).
Residents: two antlered deer total across archery and firearms seasons, only one before Nov 14 in archery. Nonresidents: one antlered deer combined (MDC season summary).
Black bear: call 800-668-4045 before each day's hunt for the zone quota status.
seasonsNote: Dates from MDC's 2026-27 Hunting Seasons at a Glance (read Nov 2, 2026). MDC notes it is not a legal document; the Wildlife Code governs. County-by-county antlerless rules apply in the firearms antlerless portions.
rut: Whitetail rut peaks in mid-November; the November firearms portion (Nov 14-24) runs during it.

parts: NR small game permit (for other game)
nr.note: Missouri nonresident deer permits are sold over the counter (no draw). The Archer's permit is a separate $360.

everywhere: Missouri permit for the game you're hunting (plus the migratory bird permit and duck stamp for waterfowl)
